jobs.description:
Are you skilled at turning financial information into a clear performance story? Can you move confidently from the detail behind the numbers to the insights that matter most? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment with senior stakeholder exposure?

The Group FP&A function owns and steers the financial performance of Pandora. The function plays a vital role in defining and enforcing the global performance management framework and policies across Global Finance and within the business – including being the driver of planning, budgeting and forecasting, defining KPIs and management reporting to the CFO and CEO. The function is therefore key to Pandora’s ability to provide the right guidance on expected future performance to the capital markets.

As Senior Manager, FP&A Reporting, you will play a key role in Pandora’s Group performance reporting, translating financial results and underlying business drivers into clear, decision-relevant insights for the CFO and CEO.

You will play a key role in the end-to-end performance reporting cycle, turning performance trends and underlying drivers into sharp insights, recommendations and actions. Working closely with Group Reporting & Accounting, Group Commercial Finance and stakeholders across Pandora, you will combine strong financial foundations with sound business judgement to turn complexity into clarity.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Own and continuously develop Pandora’s end-to-end Group performance reporting, including clear and decision-relevant commentary.

• 
Lead the preparation of the monthly and quarterly Group Business Performance Reviews and closing reviews delivering a high-quality reporting pack that clearly highlights key results, business drivers, risks and opportunities.

• 
Prepare executive and Board reporting, translating financial information into concise, actionable insights.

• 
Coordinate FP&A activities related to monthly, quarterly and annual closing in close partnership with Group Reporting & Accounting and other Finance teams.

• 
Analyze performance against budget, forecast and prior periods, including key drivers across revenue, gross margin, costs and cash flow.

• 
Play a key role in the governance and reporting of like-for-like performance, including system logic and definitions, ensuring LFL is consistently applied as a key performance measure.

• 
Serve as the centre of excellence for Group reporting methodology and the management reporting package, ensuring one set of numbers

• 
Partner with our Global Cost Transformation office on reporting and follow-up of initiatives and financial benefits.

• 
Continuously improve the structure, content and quality of Group performance reporting and commentary, driving simplification, standardization and automation across reporting processes and ways of working.

What We’re Looking For

You are a business-minded finance professional with a strong technical foundations and the ability to turn detailed analysis into a compelling executive-level performance story.

What You Bring

• 
Relevant experience from a similar role within Group Finance, FP&A or controlling in a larger international organization.

• 
A robust accounting foundation and a solid understanding of the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, including working capital.

• 
Experience with monthly closing, Group consolidation, management reporting and performance-review processes.

• 
Proven ability to translate financial results into clear, concise insights for CFO and/or Board-level audiences.

• 
Sound business acumen and judgement, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and focus on what matters most.

• 
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.

• 
A proactive mindset, anticipating needs and raising issues and opportunities early rather than simply reacting to requests.

• 
A track record of improving, simplifying or automating finance and reporting processes, supported by advanced systems, Excel and PowerPoint skills.

• 
Comfort working in a complex international environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

Additional information

• Career Band 4A

Did we get your attention?

If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe’s Best Workplaces and ranked #1 among Danish companies, Pandora is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that reflecting the diversity of society in how we engage with our customers is essential to fulfilling our purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We are dedicated to nurturing a culture where everyone feels respected, valued.

Help us build the future of workforce orchestration

Worklinq is a leading provider of Workforce Management solutions, with our software being used by more than 300,000 employees across some of Europe’s most well-known Enterprises. We are currently looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to join our dedicated, international DevOps team. As a DevOps Engineer you will play a critical role in building, maintaining, and scaling our modern cloud setup, helping us take our platform and out processes to the next level.

What you bring

We are looking for a pragmatic, and solution-oriented team player with an agile "can-do" attitude and enterprise-grade experience. You will become part of a highly skilled team valuing collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Strongly preferred qualifications:

• Solid experience with Kubernetes management, security and optimization

• Infrastructure as code using Terraform

• Microsoft Azure platform and Azure DevOps

• Solid Git knowledge, ideally with experience in the GitHub ecosystem

• CI/CD, Jenkins, GitOps and Argo CD

• Monitoring, metrics and observability on Azure and Kubernetes

• Highly structured approach to processes, automation and documentation

• Strong analytical skills for troubleshooting and optimizations

• Fluency in English, spoken and in writing

Preferred & nice-to-have qualifications:

• Build engineering experience, including pipeline design and release management

• Strong Linux knowledge and experience

• Experience with Progress OpenEdge

• Experience with FinOps, reservations and cost management on MS Azure

• Experience with strengthening and optimizing DevOps work using AI tools

What we offer

We’re currently scaling to new heights, bringing our Workforce Management solution into the future as a full-scale cloud SaaS platform. You’ll be joining one of the industry’s most innovative tech environments, working with a massive lineup of major global and local market leaders.

Our roots are in Denmark, where you’ll find our HQ, but we operate across borders with fantastic teams in Sweden, Norway, the UK and Romania. We collaborate closely across geographies and teams, and value diversity in culture and mindset. We gather the whole international family once or twice a year, topped up with frequent local team nights and social get-togethers. We offer a competitive salary, opportunities for personal growth and private medical insurance.

Ready to make an impact?

Hurry up and submit your application. We look forward to hearing from you.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**SimCorp is developing a new game changing Software-as-a-Service solution for Performance Measurement and Attribution, which will allow Investment Managers to interact with, and analyze their investments in a modern web application. It is connected to a high-performance computing calculation engine in the back-end, thus combining more than 50 years of industry-leading experience of SimCorp with a modern user experience and cloud computing, enabling users to do in minutes what used to take hours.

We welcome applications from both early‑career and mid‑career software engineers.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Build solutions: collaborate closely with your team, Product Managers, Architects, peers and end-users to deliver high-quality, secure and valuable solutions in the Performance Product Area.

• Contribute across the entire development lifecycle - from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.

• Coordinate and execute on development and maintenance of the investment performance solution in collaboration with product owners and other teams.

• Think beyond the code: Understand our strategy, goals and customer needs to enhance SimCorp’s impact.

• You will work closely with experienced engineers who support your development. Over time, you will grow into taking ownership of larger components and may mentor more junior colleagues as your experience grows.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• Solid knowledge of C#, .NET Core/Framework, and object-oriented design principles.

• Experience with APIs.

• Familiarity with modern engineering practices, including CI/CD pipelines and trunk-based development. We use Git (Azure DevOps).

• Interest in cloud engineering. We use Microsoft Azure.

• You understand the importance of automated testing of business‑critical functionality and quality assurance practices.

• Willingness to dive into a complex domain, working with finance, investment performance & attribution and investment-related instruments.

• You are able to solve complex problems in a structured manner.

• You are enthusiastic about building state-of-the-art software, and have the mindset needed to make others understand your ideas.

• Curiosity and adaptability to learn in-house tools and frameworks - including the APL programming language (no prior experience in APL required, we provide extensive training).

• You are good at coordinating with both programmers and non-programmers, to ensure a full understanding of tasks.

• You have a Master’s degree or higher within Computer Sciences, Engineering, Finance, Physics, Mathematics, Economics or similar experience.

• If you have knowledge of a financial domain it is plus, otherwise we will bring you up to speed using technical discussions, training and a comprehensive onboarding program.

**What Is It Like To Work Here

**SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys.

**Benefits

**Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work & life balance: flexible work hours, a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have 3 weeks per quarter you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

**_Do you want to help deliver high-voltage cable projects? Can you take the technical lead from detailed design through procurement, construction and handover? And do you bring an electrical background and experience with high-voltage installations? Then join COWI and put your expertise to work.

_**

**Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**

As our project portfolio grows, so does the need for Technical Leads to support the delivery of high-voltage cable installations. We are looking for a Technical Lead to join COWI.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Compose of concept design, cost estimates, project program timelines etc.

• Develop detailed designs for cable routes, horizontal directional drilling solutions between two or more substations in collaboration with other disciplines in respect to environmental- landowner issues in the project organisation.

• Perform cable ampacity design and electrical studies with standard software applications

• Develop technical requirements for procurement of supply/installation contracts followed up by tender evaluation and contract negotiations

• Participate in external meetings and manage contact with various stakeholders.

• Contribute to substation projects to ensure that cable installations can be routed to the relevant bays.

• Drive technical project delivery and facilitate construction meetings on site.

• Coordinate factory & site testing, quality assurance documentation and handover.

Travel in Denmark in connection with the projects will be part of the role.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways, but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

You take a proactive, collaborative and solution-oriented approach to your work and are comfortable managing several tasks at the same time.

On top of that, you will have:

• An electrical background, for example as an electrical engineer, Installatør or maskinmester.

• Experience with the establishment of high-voltage installations.

• Relevant experience in driving projects forward.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

**A place to work and so much more

**

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Got more questions?

**

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Head of Discipline Pia Alrøe at PIAL@COWI.COM.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Want to be a part of a fantastic adventure?

We are now looking for an Inhouse Sales Agent

Skills & qualifications needed

•

• 
You either speak one of the Scandinavian languages or English

• 
Highly organised with strong written and verbal communication skills

•

• 
Hospitality mindset

You identify with the following

You thrive in a high pressure and dynamic environment ensuring a consistently high level of productivity and operational standards paying particular attention to details. You are a true team player, approachable and have a can-do attitude. You are a Cosmopolitan spirit with a genuine love for Copenhagen and Mother Earth.

Responsibilities

• 
Respond to incoming inquiries from clients and timely follow up

What we can offer (amongst other things)

Together with a team of dedicated and passionate people, you have the chance to put your very personal imprint and create a Villa Copenhagen that you - and we - are proud to be part of. Are we the perfect match?

The position is a full-time position, reporting to the Director of Sales

If you see yourself in the description above, we’d love to hear from you! Please upload your CV and answer a few quick screening questions by 27th of November to let us know who you are. We look forward to reviewing your application.

For questions, please contact the Director at Sales at tina.hansen@nordichotels.com (no applications)

Interviews will be held throughout the application period.

We hire attitude ….and train skills

jobs.occupation: Junior 1st Line IT Supporter for the Nordic team – Copenhagen Area/Malmø (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Redo to take your first step into IT support and learn from experienced colleagues?

At Egmont IT, we are now looking for a Junior 1st Line IT Supporter for our office in Copenhagen Area/Malmø. You will be part of a distributed, close-knit Nordic IT team with colleagues in Sweden, Denmark and Norway.

In this role, you will handle day-to-day IT tickets with support and guidance from experienced colleagues. You will build your technical skills, learn how a professional service desk works and grow into a confident IT supporter. No two days are the same, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience.

Main responsibilities:

- Receive, analyze and resolve incoming IT tickets via the ticketing system, phone and chat, and escalate to 2nd/3rd line when needed.

- Handle standard user administration, permissions and licenses in Microsoft 365 / Entra ID (Azure AD)and Active Directory, following established procedures.

- Provide first-line troubleshooting and support for clients (Windows/macOS), network/VPN, hardware and software.

- Keep users informed and make sure tickets are clearly and correctly documented.

- Help create and update technical documentation and knowledge base (KB) articles.

- Flag recurring problems and suggest ideas for improvements.

- Collaborate with 2nd/3rd line, operations and infrastructure teams in the Nordics.

- Support colleagues on-site in Copenhagen with local issues that cannot be resolved remotely.

We are looking for someone who:

- Has 0–2 years of experience in IT support/Service Desk, or relevant education, internship or student job in IT.

- Has basic knowledge of Microsoft 365, Active Directory/Entra ID, Windows/macOS and networking (e.g. DNS, DHCP, VPN).

Why Egmont?

At Egmont IT, we enable creativity, not just for artist but also in tech. Behind every story, movie, game, or digital experience lies a foundation of stable and secure technology — and that’s where we come in.

Egmont is a foundation, meaning all our profits are reinvested into developing our media companies and donated to support vulnerable children and young people.

You’ll join an international IT organization with a strong purpose and culture. We believe in flexibility, trust, and development. You’ll have freedom to influence our cloud journey, collaborate with talented colleagues across the Nordics and Europe, and grow through certifications and learning opportunities. A key role in a cloud-driven operations team. A workplace that encourages innovation, collaboration, and autonomy. A chance to make a real difference — We bring stories to life

Would you like to be part of the team?

Logistics & How to Apply

• Location: Copenhagen

• Application deadline: November 26, 2026

• Employment type: Full-time, permanent

Please send your application as soon as possible — we review applications continuously. Applications are welcome in both Danish and English.

If you have any questions regarding the position, feel free to contact Director Rune Hald at rune.hald@egmont.com.

To apply, please use the "Apply Now" button on this page. Note that we do not accept applications via email.

About Egmont

Egmont is a leading Nordic media group focused on strong content and platforms within film, tv, cinema, streaming, gaming, e-commerce, marketing services, educational platforms, magazines and books. Proud owner of strong companies like Nordisk Film, TV 2 in Norway, Lindhardt og Ringhof and Story House Egmont. Being a foundation, all profit is reinvested in our media companies and donated to help improve the lives of vulnerable children and young people and support film talents.

We bring stories to life.

**Job Description

**Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments, working with some of the most complex and modern data solutions on the market? Are you ready to take ownership of shaping data architecture? If so, you might be our next colleague.

In Data Management, you join a team that enables our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

As a Senior Data Architect, you will work in the intersection of technology and business. Data is at the core of everything we do, and our analyses, advice, and solutions consistently create real value for our customers. Your work involve developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, distribute, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, Spark, Kafka, Dagster, Airflow, Terraform and others.

**Responsibilites

**

• Designing, modeling, and building data solutions such as data platforms, data warehouse architecture, and business intelligence applications.

• Taking co-ownership of data architecture, defining technical direction, and driving customer advisory, data strategy, and business analysis in collaboration with the project team and customer.

• Leading and mentoring team members, prioritizing and organizing work, and providing technical guidance and direction.

• Quickly getting up to speed on existing solutions and taking ownership of them, while defining the right path forward for new projects based on best practices.

• Performing technical quality assurance and reviews on data models, ETL processes, and solution architecture across projects.

**About You

**You hold a relevant degree in data science, software engineering, computer science, mathematical modelling, or a similar field, along with solid professional experience in data management. Through your professional experience, you have gained deep technical expertise and a structured, logical approach to solving complex data challenges. As a Senior Data Architect, you are comfortable stepping into a leadership role guiding both people and the technical direction, and you thrive in a collaborative, development-oriented environment with a focus on continuous learning.

To succeed in this role, you have significant experience with:

• Designing and implementing data solutions, including data modelling, ETL/ELT, and data warehousing.

• Multiple languages and technologies such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R, as well as Fabric, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, Databricks, Dagster, Terraform and others.

• Business Intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.

• Supporting customers and colleagues through professional expertise and guidance.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

**Continue developing with us

**At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

**Send us your application

**Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

Lead engineering at a profitable, funded proptech while the team is still small enough to shape.

• Want to set the technical direction for a growing team and still ship code yourself?

• How would you keep a small team shipping to production many times a day, with review and testing that catch problems before customers do, without every decision landing on your desk?

• Where would you draw the line between what an AI agent should suggest and what it can do on a property owner’s behalf?

Sounds like you? Then you might be our next CTO!

A property owner with a portfolio of buildings has a practical question: which repairs belong in next year’s budget, and which can wait?

At Proprty.ai, our models estimate the condition and remaining life of building components and the energy and CO2 effect of improving them. Our software turns those estimates into maintenance plans, and our AI agent, Tily, helps owners analyze their portfolios and take action!

Our product went live in 2024 and is used by customers in Denmark, Norway and Germany. We reached profitability by the end of 2025 and raised DKK 21 million in April 2026, and we are not planning to stop there!

There is still so much we can do to make it even better, and you could help shape the future of building maintenance and how engineering is run at Proprty.ai.

Product: TypeScript, React and Next.js on Vercel, with Supabase (PostgreSQL, row-level security, storage).

Data and models: Python and PySpark on Databricks (Azure, EU), Python model services, and LLM features on Azure OpenAI. We also run a customer API and an MCP server.

What you get to shape

The team and the code.

You'll lead our product engineering team, work closely with our data engineers and our Chief Data Science Officer, and keep building core features yourself.

You might coach a developer through a tricky problem in the morning and ship a feature yourself that afternoon. You'll own engineering hiring as the team grows, from deciding which roles we need to choosing the people you want on the team.

How we build and ship.

You’ll own the platform’s architecture and how we test and release. We release to production many times a day. Your job is to keep that pace while making every release reliable and secure.

When an urgent customer request competes with longer-term platform work, you’ll make the call and explain what comes first and why.

Shape what Tily can do next.

Our data scientists build models for building condition, remaining life, cost, and energy across several European markets.

Together with our Chief Data Science Officer, you'll get those models in front of customers, decide what Tily may do on an owner's behalf, and use feedback from property owners, Sales, and Customer Success to choose the next problems to solve.

Change how we use AI ourselves.

Change how we use AI ourselves. Our engineers build with Claude Code and Cursor, AI agents review every pull request in our CI/CD pipeline, and agents take on routine work end to end so the team can ship faster.

We keep looking for new ways AI can raise our pace, and you'll lead that.

We talk a lot (in a good way). When a problem gets tricky, we pull up a chair and pair on it. We like having a laugh while we figure things out.

What you’ll bring?

You've been CTO or head of engineering at a startup or scale-up while the product, the team, and the rules were still taking shape, and you can show what changed because you were there.

You know when to open a pull request yourself, when to let another engineer make the call, and which shortcut will come back to bite you two releases from now.

You bring curiosity about our industry, our customers' problems, and the business acumen to understand how our product delivers business value, so that you can help facilitate features that drive outcomes and make our users' lives easier.

We’re AI-first (the name’s a bit of a giveaway). If you’ve built an agent or shipped an AI feature, we’d love to hear what happened after the demo. What did customers trust it to do, and where did they want the controls back? You’ll get to make those calls with Tily and figure out where AI helps our own engineers ship better software.

The core of what we consider for a candidate

• You’ve led an engineering team, coached developers, and hired people to join it.

• You’re keen to build AI agents that customers can put to work and to explore where AI makes your own team more effective.

• You still build full-stack features with React, TypeScript, and SQL. You can take a feature from technical design through thoughtful user experience to release, and measure what happens when customers get their hands on it.

• Fluent in English

Experience we’d love to hear about

• Taking an engineering team from a startup to a scale-up phase, understanding how and when to mature processes as the team scales, and how that looks different in this new AI era.

• Shipping an AI agent or feature into production. We’re especially curious about what you changed after people started using it.

• How you’ve spoken with customers and industry experts to help ensure we’re on the forefront of solving the right problems in our platform

• Your perspective on the role of a CTO as a thought leader.

• Working with PostgreSQL or Next.js, or building products for real estate or proptech.

Where we work

We spend 4 days a week together in our office near Rådhuspladsen. You’ll need to be based in the Copenhagen area, as we can’t offer relocation or visa sponsorship for this role.

New to proptech? That’s fine. If you’ve led engineers and still enjoy being one, we’d love to hear from you.

Questions? Reach out to Casper høgh at Csh@ing.dk, who helps us land the right human for the job

Our hiring process

• Intro call with Casper Høgh – We’ll talk about your background, what you want from your next CTO role, and any questions you have about proprty.ai.

• In-person interview – Meet us at our Copenhagen office for a small demo and talk through the team, the decisions you’d own, and how you like to lead while staying hands-on.

• Case interview – Work through an engineering scenario with us. We want to understand what you’d prioritize, which trade-offs you see, and why.

• Board interview - Meet with one of our board members. Get their perspective on our journey and talk them through how you would help us in our next phase of growth.

• Offer – If we both see a fit, we’ll talk through the offer and next steps together.

TL;DR

Want to get in early with a great team? Love leading engineers and still writing code?

Apply now to lead our dev team and make building maintenance smarter and more sustainable with AI.

jobs.occupation: Sales Development Representatives for the Swedish and Finnish Markets, Copenhagen based
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by new business, building relationships and creating measurable results?

At EasyTable, you will become part of an international sales team in Copenhagen, working directly with restaurants across one of Nordic markets.

We are looking for two Sales Development Representatives to join our team: one to develop the Swedish market and one to develop the Finnish market.

Both roles involve creating business opportunities, building relationships with restaurant owners and demonstrating the value EasyTable can bring to their business.

You will take ownership of your own sales activities and drive opportunities forward from first contact to a paying customer.

This is an opportunity to build a career in B2B sales in Copenhagen while working directly with one of the Nordic markets and taking ownership of your own customer pipeline.

The position

We Are Hiring For Two Separate Positions

• Swedish Market: Responsible for growing EasyTable's customer base in Sweden.

• Finnish Market: Responsible for growing EasyTable's customer base in Finland.

Both positions are focused on proactive sales, where you will manage your own pipeline and work towards clear individual targets.

You will be based at our office in Østerbro, Copenhagen, working alongside an international team while taking ownership of developing your assigned market.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Identify and proactively reach out to restaurant owners across your assigned market

• Understand potential customers' businesses, challenges and needs

• Book and conduct online demonstrations of EasyTable

• Present EasyTable's value proposition based on each restaurant's needs

• Follow up consistently and drive opportunities from first contact to agreement

About You

Depending on which market you will be responsible for, you should:

• Speak and write Swedish at a native level (Swedish Market) or Finnish at a native level (Finnish Market)

• Be able to communicate professionally in English

• Enjoy proactive sales and reaching out to new potential customers

• Be confident speaking with customers by phone and in online meetings

• Be good at building trust and relationships

• Take responsibility for your own performance and follow opportunities through

• Be motivated by targets and seeing the direct results of your work

• As we are looking for someone to start at the beginning of next month, or as soon as possible thereafter, we ideally expect candidates to already be based in Copenhagen or the surrounding area.

Previous experience with B2B sales is an advantage, but it is not a requirement. Motivation, commercial drive and the willingness to learn are important to us.

What can you expect from us?

You will get a role with clear goals, responsibility for your own sales activities and the opportunity to directly influence your earnings.

We Offer

• A fixed salary plus uncapped commission based on your results

• Thorough onboarding in EasyTable, our product and our sales process

• Ongoing coaching and support to develop your sales skills

• An international working environment with colleagues from different backgrounds

• A modern office in Østerbro, Copenhagen

• Option to participate in our attractive company lunch programme

• Friday bars and other social activities

• Free Red Bull, tea and coffee at the office

Working hours

This is a full-time position of 37 hours per week. We offer flexibility in how you structure your working day, and your hours may vary depending on your preferences and the market you work with.

About EasyTable

EasyTable is a restaurant booking platform that helps restaurants manage reservations and create better experiences for their guests. From our Copenhagen office, our international team works with restaurants across Europe.

As a Sales Development Representative, you will play an important role in growing our customer base in your assigned market and introducing more restaurants to EasyTable. You will join a team where sales performance, personal responsibility and development are central, while working in a social and international environment in Copenhagen.

Could this be you?

If you speak and write Swedish or Finnish at a native level, live in or around Copenhagen and are motivated by building a career in B2B sales, we would like to hear from you.

Please specify in your application whether you are interested in the Swedish or Finnish market.

Send your CV and application here or to the email provided under contact information.

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact HR & Recruitment Assistant Emilia Bech (Working hours: Monday, Wednesday and Thursday from 9:00 to 14:00).

Highlights

• Full-Stack Python/TS engineer needed for a B2B SaaS startup in Copenhagen (with plenty of traction!)

• We have a lean, get-stuff-done team. No annoying extra management layers or unnecessary bureaucratic rituals. And we are "AI-forward" in our own development practices.

• You will own features end to end, from the data model through to the screen, on a platform that manufacturers rely on to keep production lines running.

• You will work in a small engineering team, directly with the person who decides what we build, and the problems you spend your time on are hard because the domain is hard, not because the organization is.

• We're building legitimately useful tools for the industries and companies that make the world go around.... manufacturers. Both AI-tools and just "plain-old-good-software" tools.

About Supplios

Manufacturers live or die by their supply base. Sourcing the wrong supplier, onboarding one slowly, failing to qualify one properly or losing track of a non-conformance can stop a production line and cost millions. Yet most manufacturers still run these relationships across email chains, spreadsheets and shared drives.

Supplios is a supplier collaboration platform for manufacturers in automotive and industrial sectors. We cover the full supplier relationship: sourcing, onboarding, qualification, day-to-day collaboration, compliance and supplier quality, all in a modern cloud based platform that is easy for manufacturers to implement and operate. It is built specifically for the way automotive and industrial manufacturers actually work.

We are headquartered in central Copenhagen and already serve customers globally in our vertical, including some of the most demanding names in automotive. We have grown to this point almost entirely on product strength, domain credibility and word of mouth.

The platform now covers more ground than the team that built it. We are hiring engineers to keep that pace sustainable, and to go deeper on the parts of the product our customers are pushing hardest.

The role

You will join a small engineering team and work across the whole stack: Python on the backend, TypeScript on the frontend and in the AI layers. There is no split between people who design and people who implement. You will take a problem from a customer conversation or a product decision through to something running in production for real manufacturers.

You will work directly with our co-founder and CEO, who is a hands-on product builder himself. That means short conversations instead of tickets thrown over a wall, and it means your questions about why something should work a certain way get answered by the person who decided it.

The domain is genuinely complicated, and that is the interesting part. Supplier relationships in automotive involve deep hierarchies, long-running approval processes, strict audit requirements and a lot of state that has to be exactly right. Modeling that well is most of the job.

Title and level flex with experience. We are open to strong mid-level engineers and to senior engineers who want more scope than their current company gives them.

We work together from our office in central Copenhagen. This is primarily an in-office role: at this stage, and on a codebase with this much implicit context, working through problems with the rest of the team in person is much faster than doing it in writing. Sensible flexibility when you need it is a given; full-time remote is not what we are offering.

Our Current Stack

• Backend: Python / Django

• Frontend: Vue (but no specific Vue experience is needed)

• Infrastructure: AWS (mostly)

• Agents: Cloudflare (TypeScript) + Claude & OpenAI platform

What you will do

• Build features end to end, from data model and backend logic through to the TypeScript frontend our customers actually click on.

• Build end-to-end / front-to-back AI features (in-app AI assistants, background worker agents, email-routing agents, customer-configurable agent framework components)

• Design and evolve the relational data model that sits under supplier relationships, approvals and quality records.

• Take vaguely defined customer problems and turn them into something specific enough to build, then build it.

• Work on integrations between Supplios and customer systems (ERP and adjacent tooling), where failures have visible consequences for a production line.

• Improve the parts of the codebase that need it, rather than routing around them.

• Review other people's code and have yours reviewed; we keep the loop tight and unbureaucratic.

• Help keep the platform healthy in production across our regions: errors, performance and the boring things that keep customers trusting us.

• Take part in product decisions. Engineers here are expected to have opinions about what we build, not just how.

What we are looking for

Essential

• Professional experience with Python. This is not negotiable; the backend is Python and you need to be effective in it.

• Solid TypeScript experience and genuine comfort working on the frontend.

• Experience building and running SaaS products, including the part after launch where real users depend on them.

• AI-forward development techniques. (This does not mean you no longer write code.)

• A track record of owning work end to end without waiting to be told what to do next.

• The temperament for a small, senior company: high ownership, low ceremony.

• You want to work primarily from an office in central Copenhagen, with a small team.

Nice to have

Genuinely a plus, not a requirement. Nobody has all of these.

• Experience with B2B enterprise SaaS, especially where customers are large and demanding and implementations are not self-serve. This is a significant plus.

• Experience with complex relational data modeling, and with large, long-lived codebases that you did not write yourself. A big plus.

• Experience building AI-based products, using the latest frameworks/harnesses and infrastructure components (including RAG) is a significant plus.

• Familiarity with any of: domain-driven design, the actor model, finite state machines, CQRS, event-driven architecture. We use these ideas where they earn their place, and it helps if the vocabulary is already yours.

• Startup experience, particularly early stage. A significant plus.

• Knowledge of manufacturing, automotive or supply chain. Useful, but we can teach you the domain; we cannot teach you the craft, so do not rule yourself out on this.

Language

English is the only important language for this position; we work in English, and so do our customers. Danish language skills are not required.

Why this role is worth your time

• The scope is unusually large for the stage. You are one of a small number of engineers on a platform that serves demanding customers globally. What you build ships, and it ships soon.

• No layers between you and the decisions. You work directly with the co-founder and CEO, who runs product. There is no committee to navigate and nobody to translate your work for you.

• Hard problems that are not artificially hard. The complexity comes from the domain (hierarchies, state, audit trails, integrations that must not fail), not from organisational overhead.

• Real customers already, and real gaps. The product has paying customers in automotive and clear places where it needs to get better. Both halves of that are true, and both are why this is a good job.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on why this role interests you to team@supplios.com. Work examples will help.

**Senior Development Engineer, VELUX Products & Innovation – Maintenance Free Window Modules – LKR Innovation House - Østbirk

****Join a team of passionate engineers and technical specialists with end-to-end responsibility for critical window modules. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges, driving product development, and creating value across the entire product lifecycle, you could be our next Senior Development Engineer.

****Meet your future team

**You will become part of the Maintenance Free Window Modules team based in Østbirk. The team has end-to-end responsibility for VELUX sash and frame mo-dules made from polyurethane and other polymers, as well as our Insulating Glass Unit (IGU) modules.

Working across the full product lifecycle, the team supports everything from concept creation and new product introduction to continuous optimization of cost, performance, sustainability, and quality. We collaborate closely with Product Management, Production, and other development teams to ensure our products continue to create value for customers and the business.

As our new Senior Development Engineer, you will act as the Module Owner of the IGU module area, driving development activities, shaping future module roadmaps, and ensuring strong cross-functional alignment across the organization.

**What We Offer

**This is an opportunity to take on a highly influential technical role with significant impact across products, processes, and stakeholders. You will work with experienced colleagues in an international environment where innovation, knowledge sharing, and collaboration are valued and encouraged.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Hold technical ownership and end-to-end responsibility for Insulating Glass Unit (IGU) modules.

• Drive module development activities across new product launches, performance improvements, cost optimization, upgrades, sustainability initiatives, and quality enhancements.

• Conduct module health assessments to evaluate performance, value creation, business relevance, and future opportunities.

• Identify, qualify, and drive opportunities that create value across the product lifecycle and value chain.

• Lead design, concept development, and resolution of complex technical challenges.

• Define and secure technical requirements, module performance, and robust engineering solutions.

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders and ensure alignment across Product Management, Production, Supply Chain, and Product Development.

• Support management decision-making through technical expertise and insights.

• Act as a knowledge leader by developing technical capabilities, facilitating learning activities, and promoting effective knowledge sharing throughout the organization.

**What You Will Bring

**You enjoy navigating complex technical environments and are motivated by combining deep technical expertise with cross-functional collaboration. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are able to balance technical excellence with business value.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Hold a Master’s degree in Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.

• Have experience working with product development or complex technical products.

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured approach to technical challenges.

• Have experience with CAD tools, preferably CREO and Windchill.

• Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.

• Demonstrate the ability to engage and align stakeholders across functions and disciplines.

• Take a proactive approach and can independently drive activities from concept to implementation.

• Have experience or knowledge into systems engineering, which is considered an advantage but not a requirement.

• Have experience or knowledge within insulating glass, glazing solutions, or related technologies, which is considered an advantage but not a requirement.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

Are you ready to drive finance-critical IT projects at the heart of ALK's journey to SAP S/4HANA — shaping how a global pharmaceutical company runs its finance reporting and analytics?

About ALK

ALK's aspiration is to become the world leader in allergy by helping as many people as possible with allergy to a better life by providing options of prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of allergy. In Global IT, we contribute to this aspiration by supporting the organization with modern IT tools and digitalisation technologies, and by delivering world-class support to our many colleagues around the world.

The Role

As a Senior IT Project Manager at ALK, you will lead important finance-related IT initiatives from inception to execution, with a central role in our S/4HANA journey. You are first and foremost a strong project manager and facilitator who can guide the business through change. Your tasks will include:

• Ensuring timely, on-budget project delivery and successful milestone achievement.

• Aligning project outcomes with the strategic vision of the business.

• Coordinating internal and third-party resources effectively.

• Facilitating workshops and supporting the business through the change process.

• Driving finance projects with an emphasis on reporting, analytics and data modelling — including the redesign of our BW setup — alongside the connected changes across the core finance ERP.

• Steering the relationship with the Steering Committee and Project Group towards collaborative success.

Being structured, organized and proactive, you will anticipate issues before they arise and know when to involve the right people at the right time.

This role is based at our headquarters in Hørsholm, Denmark, where you will work closely with the hiring manager and senior finance leadership. As our SAP team is located in Madrid and much of the finance team sits in Kraków, you can expect regular travel to both locations.

What We're Seeking

We are on the lookout for a candidate with:

• A master’s degree in engineering, business or relevant fields.

• Proven experience in IT project management, ideally with finance, reporting or analytics projects.

• Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills, and the ability to support a business through change.

• A structured, organized and proactive working style.

• Familiarity with SAP, S/4HANA and BW/data modelling — you don't need to be an expert, but you should be comfortable operating in this landscape and speaking with the specialists. Having already been part of an S/4HANA journey is a strong advantage.

• Willingness to travel internationally, primarily to Madrid and Kraków.

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

• Familiarity with GxP pharma environments is desirable, but not mandatory.

Why ALK Global IT?

ALK's IT division is a robust team of approximately 150 professionals with IT hubs in Hørsholm, Madrid, Kraków, and with employees throughout our production and sales networks in Germany, France, North America and China. We prioritize professional growth and learning, valuing competency and knowledge exchange over formalities and encouraging a collaborative spirit every day.

Become a part of ALK

ALK provides a dynamic and accommodating work environment, complete with inspiring and challenging assignments. You are able to actively influence and challenge the status quo. Our flat structures attract independent individuals who like to feel the progress of the business and enjoy being close to the decision-making process.

We operate production sites in Denmark, France, Spain, and the United States, with a global team of approximately 2,800 employees. Our headquarters is located in the scenic DTU Science Park in Hørsholm, Denmark, which will be your primary workplace for this role.

Join us at ALK and be a part of an organization that values integrity, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of those we serve.

**Join Group Treasury at our headquarters in Faxe

**As part of our Group Treasury team, you will play a central role in managing the Group's treasury activities and supporting strategic financial decision-making. The Group Treasury-team reports directly to Executive Management and works closely with other headquarters functions, subsidiaries, and our Shared Service Centre in Lithuania. The position is based at our headquarters in Faxe.

**A Key Role with Broad Responsibility

****Responsibilities

**As Treasury Manager, you will work across a wide range of treasury disciplines, combining operational execution with strategic analysis. Your responsibilities will include:

• Preparing and maintaining the weekly Group cash flow forecast, including follow-up with subsidiaries to support liquidity planning and working capital initiatives.

• Managing Group cash management activities, including daily optimization of liquidity positions and continuous development of the Group's banking structure.

• Monitoring and reporting financial risks, including foreign exchange, commodity, and interest rate exposures, and providing hedging recommendations in line with the Group Treasury Policy.

• Executing transactions in aluminum, gas, foreign exchange, and interest rate swaps.

• Preparing and reporting the Group's financial items on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis.

• Conducting ad hoc analyses related to financial risks, bank debt, performance, and other treasury-related topics.

• Supporting the management of the Group's insurance program.

In addition, you will act as a trusted financial specialist across the organization, supporting colleagues with treasury and finance-related questions. You will also contribute to managing banking relationships, funding activities, and the ongoing development of treasury operations and strategic initiatives.

**Our Culture

**We believe in freedom with responsibility. Our leadership style is built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Team members are empowered to take ownership of their responsibilities while knowing support is always available when needed.

We also value a healthy work-life balance and strive to create an environment where people can perform at their best while maintaining flexibility and well-being.

**Why Join Us?

**This is an exciting career opportunity that will give you direct exposure to Executive Management in a listed company. You will have the opportunity to influence business decisions through insightful analysis, sound financial recommendations, and proactive risk management.

You will join an ambitious organization with a strong market position and a dynamic growth agenda. The role offers significant responsibility, professional challenges, and varied tasks within a highly capable and collaborative team. You will also build a broad network across the organization and benefit from excellent career and development opportunities.

**Your Profile

****We Are Looking For a Candidate Who Brings

**

• A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience within treasury, finance, banking, or a related field.

• A university degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a similar discipline (e.g., MSc in Finance, Economics, or equivalent).

• Strong analytical capabilities and a solid understanding of treasury processes and financial instruments.

• A commercial mindset with the ability to translate financial insights into practical business solutions.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**In Addition, You

**

• Are advanced Excel user with a strong interest in financial systems and technology.

• Have experience with treasury management systems; SAP experience is considered an advantage.

• Are fluent in English, written and spoken.

**Personal Qualities

**You enjoy balancing deep analytical work with hands-on operational responsibilities and thrive in a role with broad organizational interaction. You are ambitious, curious, and confident in challenging established ways of working. At the same time, you bring positive energy, resilience, and a collaborative approach to your work.

**Does this sound like you?

**If you are motivated by combining analytical depth with business impact, and you thrive in a collaborative environment where ideas quickly turn into action, then you may be the colleague we're looking for. We look forward to receiving your application.

At Royal Unibrew, you'll find the industry's most dedicated, energetic, and experienced colleagues. Together, we build the best framework for a job that precisely matches your everyday life and career aspirations.

Royal Unibrew produces, markets, sells, and distributes quality beverages. We are a consortium of more than 35 breweries and beverage producers from across Denmark, known especially for our traditional, locally-rooted brands such as Faxe Kondi, Egekilde, Royal Beer, Ceres, and Odense Pilsner, as well as partner brands like Pepsi MAX and Heineken.

Today, we are the second-largest beverage company in Denmark. Our journey began in 1856, and we still maintain a strong commercial focus, a clear growth strategy, and an ambitious sustainability strategy - both domestically and internationally.

You'll have over 1500 colleagues in Denmark and more than 2700 colleagues outside the country, including in Finland, Italy, France, Norway, Canada, the Netherlands, and the Baltic countries.

With us, you'll be part of challenging the boundaries of sustainable production and distribution. You'll help ensure a diverse range of beverages that bring people together - on the dance floor, during the third half, or over a meal - all while contributing to strengthening Danish sports, music, and community life.

**Project Manager – Operations

****Location: Lyngby, Denmark

**Do you have a proven track record of turning complex operational challenges into tangible results? Are you motivated by getting close to manufacturing operations, analysing performance and working with teams to implement improvements that make a measurable difference?

We are looking for a Project Manager who combines strong analytical and problem-solving capability with the drive, resilience and hands-on approach required to deliver outcomes in complex manufacturing environments.

If you enjoy taking ownership, solving difficult problems and seeing your work translate into improved operational performance, this could be your next career move.

**The position

**As a Project Manager, you will work as part of our internal operations and manufacturing consulting team, delivering complex improvement, operational readiness and ramp up projects across our global manufacturing network.

This is not a traditional PMO or project coordination role.

You will be expected to get close to the operation, spend time on the shop floor, understand what is really happening within the production environment and use data and structured problem-solving to identify opportunities for improvement.

More importantly, your responsibility does not end when the solution has been identified. You will work alongside manufacturing teams and stakeholders to turn recommendations into actions and deliver tangible operational outcomes.

Our projects are typically intensive assignments, with project teams substantially dedicated to one project at a time. Assignments will often run for six to twelve months and can sometimes continue for longer.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Taking ownership of project workstreams and operational improvement initiatives from diagnosis through to implementation and delivery.

• Driving operational readiness and ramp-up of new production lines, helping manufacturing operations achieve stable target performance.

• Working directly with manufacturing sites and shop-floor teams to understand operational challenges and identify bottlenecks, losses and improvement opportunities.

• Analysing operational performance data and developing capacity models, process maps and improvement scenarios.

• Translating complex analysis into clear recommendations, practical implementation roadmaps and measurable actions.

• Driving implementation and following improvements through to tangible operational outcomes.

• Working with production teams to establish sustainable changes in performance and ways of working.

• Collaborating with stakeholders across manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain and site leadership.

• Influencing stakeholders and maintaining momentum when implementation is challenging or priorities change.

• Communicating progress, risks, recommendations and outcomes clearly to relevant stakeholders and project leadership.

This is a hands on role. You should be comfortable moving between analytical problem-solving and the realities of implementation on the manufacturing shop floor.

The position is based in Lyngby, Denmark, and requires flexibility for up to 50% global travel.

Travel requirements will depend on project assignment and may change throughout a project. The ability and willingness to travel flexibly according to business and project requirements is therefore an essential requirement of the position.

**Qualifications

**We are looking for someone who can demonstrate a proven track record of delivering outcomes, rather than simply participating in projects.

You combine strong intellectual and analytical capability with the practical judgement, resilience and persistence required to turn ideas into results.

**To Succeed In This Role, You

**

• Hold a relevant degree in engineering, science, business administration, economics or another relevant discipline.

• Have relevant professional experience within areas such as manufacturing, operational excellence, operations consulting, engineering, supply chain, procurement or complex cross-functional project work.

• Can demonstrate a proven track record of taking ownership and delivering tangible outcomes through projects, operational improvements or complex cross-functional initiatives.

• Demonstrate strong analytical and structured problem-solving capability.

• Are comfortable personally analysing operational data and using it to identify performance gaps, bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.

• Can translate analysis into practical recommendations and then follow those recommendations through implementation.

• Are comfortable working hands-on with manufacturing sites and shop-floor teams.

• Can operate effectively in complex and ambiguous environments where the solution may not initially be obvious.

• Demonstrate strong stakeholder management, collaboration and communication skills.

• Have the resilience and persistence to continue driving change when implementation is difficult or initial solutions do not deliver the expected results.

• Are professionally proficient in English.

• Are able and willing to travel globally for up to 50% of your time according to project requirements.

Relevant experience from operations or management consulting can be particularly valuable, including experience gained within operational practices or projects.

We are also interested in candidates from complex manufacturing environments such as pharmaceuticals, automotive, aerospace and FMCG, particularly where you have worked with operational improvement, production ramp-up, manufacturing performance or Lean ways of working.

Pharmaceutical manufacturing, GMP and validation experience are advantageous but are not essential.

Experience working within a Lean manufacturing environment can also be beneficial. Formal Lean certification is not required.

Likewise, formal project management qualifications such as PMP or PRINCE2 are not a requirement. We place greater emphasis on your demonstrated ability to structure problems, work with people, take ownership and deliver measurable outcomes.

**About The Department

**You will join Drug Product Manufacturing Excellence, a global unit responsible for driving performance improvements, operational readiness and transformation across Novo's manufacturing network.

The team operates as an internal operations and manufacturing consultancy, supporting our manufacturing organisation with complex operational challenges.

Our colleagues bring diverse professional backgrounds, including operations and management consulting, Novo manufacturing and support functions, and industries such as automotive, aerospace and FMCG.

What brings the team together is the ability to combine analytical problem-solving with hands-on implementation.

Our projects can include operational readiness and ramp-up of new production lines, improving capacity and performance within existing operations and solving complex cross-functional manufacturing challenges.

Rather than managing several projects simultaneously, our project teams are typically substantially dedicated to one assignment, allowing them to work closely with the operation and remain involved from diagnosis through to implementation.

As a Project Manager, you will have meaningful ownership within these assignments and will be expected to demonstrate that your work ultimately translates into operational outcomes.

The role provides significant exposure to different manufacturing environments, functions and senior stakeholders across our global organisation and offers opportunities to progress towards increasingly complex project and leadership responsibilities.

**Working at Novo

**Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

**What We Offer

**There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

**Salary And Benefits

**Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000 to 956,900 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Incentives And Benefits

**The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

**More information

**Please apply in English and refrain from adding a photo to your CV to ensure fair and efficient processing.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo, we recognise that it is no longer good enough to aspire to be the best company in the world. We need to aspire to be the best company for the world and we know that this is only possible with talented employees with diverse perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. We are therefore committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates the diversity of our employees, the patients we serve and communities we operate in. Together, we're life changing.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Data Center Technician II, Global Server Operations
jobs.description:
**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience in diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols.

• Experience with performing component-level repairs on IT equipment.

• Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and to exert physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.

• Must have the ability to work non-standard hours, including weekends, holidays and on shift-based schedule as required.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Certification in online Google IT Support Professional Certificate program.

• 2 years of experience in diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols.

• Experience in working within a data center or network operation center environment.

• Ability to collaborate and partner with teams to overcome tests.

• Ability to adapt to changes in a changing work environment.

**About The Job

**Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology.
